mentions.name: Hyvor Relay
mentions.description: Hyvor Relay is an open-source, self-hosted email sending service built as an alternative to AWS SES and Mailgun, implementing SMTP-based email delivery with the associated DNS configuration. It is approaching a beta release.
mentions.problem: Reliance on proprietary hosted email delivery services like AWS SES and Mailgun.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the past two months, I have been working on Hyvor Relay [1], an open-source, self-hosted alternative to AWS SES, Mailgun. It's been an awesome ride learning SMTP and DNS in depth. And, we're pretty close to a beta release.
